## 14 Element 10's one route: the walk an assigned employee performs, served from the query handler and from nothing else.

The handler holds the projection and no write model, so the read path cannot drift into the aggregate (http.no-write-model-in-read). The list is generated per request — it is a snapshot, and no source says it is regenerated under a walking employee (element 10 DEFAULT-3).

Method and path
: `GET` `/processing/{processingId}/pick-list`

Authentication
: `bearer JWT`
